reviews.title: Poor selection and way overpriced
reviews.text: This app has a terrible selection of manga, there’s very few actual titles on the app. And to read more than one chapter you need to subscribe. It’s $50 for a year which is an awful price for almost no titles when you can just read manga for free online. Please don’t give these people your money.

reviews.title: What do you mean I can’t even use it unless I invite friends?
reviews.text: Big annoying setup process that’s definitely just data harvesting. You want my birthday? Sure. Don’t care. But I was asked to rate the app before I was even allowed to use it. Asked my gender for *some reason* as if that matters. Genre preferences, sure… but the it told me to invite three contacts with no way to skip it. I was never given a chance to actually use the app. I’m not inviting people to an app I haven’t actually used.

reviews.title: Terrible Contact/ Subscription Cancellation
reviews.text: I have tried quite a few of times to quit my subscription of 10$ a week. There’s no way to do it in the app, I can’t quit it through my settings, I’ve tried emailing them but have gotten no response. Now I’m having to go through my bank to dispute it. I’d rather use a different platform and I wish I never purchased anything through them.

reviews.title: Can’t try before paying
reviews.text:
That’s totally normal to require payments. We’re in adult world. But you’ve got to give potential customers at least a short trial period. I don’t want to pay even 6 euro to just check if a title I want to read is available there. If it has proper quality. If your app ergonomics is acceptable. Even if it’s all good, 6 euro a week is too expensive. But anyway, I could pay this, if I had an opportunity to check what I am buying.

Without seeing what I am buying, sorry guys, no way — I just deleted it.
And looking at how much that resembles a typical scam application, I anticipate now that your content is pirated and my money wouldn’t support the author, as well.

reviews.title: Incorrect panel order
reviews.text: I was enjoying Jojolion and the ability to download chapters with this app, until the story seemed to have weird jumps. The later chapters incorrectly order the panels, which can be very confusing and ruin the story. Thankfully, mangadex has the correct order (with the same translators, meaning this is mangareader’s fault). I will not be using this app any longer, but I did appreciate when they took the effort to correctly order the manga.

reviews.title: No Trial Before You Buy
reviews.text: It immediately asks for a subscription when you download.  No chance to look at the library (even if you can’t access to read without paying.)  No chance to try it for 7, 3, or even 1 day as a trial before paying.  Just expecting you to take on blind faith that they have the Manga you want to read, something I’m not willing to do.  I’ll find an app with a trial or a chance to look at the library.  This is too much of a gamble.

reviews.title: Why?
reviews.text:
First of all subscription model of this is ridiculous. If it was one time fee I could get over it but no one wants another reoccurring fee. And if you’re going to be charging WEEKLY then the app should be the best it can be but it’s not. First impressions were admittedly positive (aside from the constant prompt whenever opening the app to pay). The animations and layout are cool. However, instantly first bug : when opening app music automatically pauses when scrolling through main page. Next is not really bugs but lack of features! 1. You can’t load directly into another chapter. 2 no full screen mode 3. No ability to rotate??? 4. Can’t get rid of page/progress marker. 5. There’s nothing that sets this apart! No spirit or unique take, only feels lacking.
I want to believe that these common features are available for the people whom are paying … it’s so worrying that all these things became obvious to me after less than 15min of using this app!! It makes me believe that the developer(s) didn’t care at all and put all recourses into aesthetics instead of actually thinking of user experience.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
Not a fan of the app pushing for payment before you get the chance to see the selection. 

I searched for a specific manga that they ended up having. Paid for the week which I think is alot for a week. Most apps have subscriptions by month not week. 

Anyway, I got a few trial chapters and then got into the premium part after subscribing, no problem. 

My issue with this app is, the next day I went to search for the manga I read the night prior and its suddenly gone as if it never existed. I try to find it under its category and am given a very small selection in a massive genre.

I messaged mangareader about the problem same day and have yet to hear back. This is quite a disappointment and a waste of my money. I was searching for a specific manga that was searchable and then the day after I pay, its gone?

Incredibly disappointing. I feel cheated.

I think the layout of the app needs alot of work especially with the genre lists not providing more than 10 or so options. I can't even see the full manga list or anything.

The manga was easy to read when I could find it but at this point I've canceled my subscription and im about ready to delete the app.

Do with that information what you will.

reviews.title: Bad selection

I’m sure there are good titles on it but it doesn’t have what most users are going to be looking for.
